(rule!
  (let* ((sorted-objs
           (sort (objects g 0)
             (lambda (a b)
               (cond
                 [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                 [else (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))]))))
         (row
           (cdr
             (flatmap
               (lambda (obj)
                 (cons 0 (for/list ([i (range (obj-size obj))]) (obj-color obj))))
               sorted-objs))))
    (list row)))
